candidates.name: Source-induced typed macro search prior
candidates.mechanism_novelty: Learn reusable typed AST abstractions from source solutions and alter future proposal probabilities; neither prewritten grammar nor execution DAG equality.
candidates.source_support_scope: Library compression and program-synthesis search; local no-LLM ablation is our extrapolation, not full LILO reproduction.
candidates.earliest_falsifier: Two learned macros versus flat and shuffled prior, identical expanded AST ceilings and 512 complete candidates; held-out literal specification solve count.
candidates.target_metric_non_equivalence: Literal specification correctness and search CPU do not establish real full-Y purchase NDCG.

candidates.name: Source-learned metaprogram edits
candidates.mechanism_novelty: Learn a transition prior over meaning-changing typed edits to complete programs; fixed primitive language, no equivalence claim or external proposer.
candidates.source_support_scope: Metaprogram search on list-processing rules; ecommerce feature adaptation is our extrapolation.
candidates.earliest_falsifier: Learned versus uniform edits from same seeds and scratch enumeration on six held-out one/two/distant-edit specifications.
candidates.target_metric_non_equivalence: List-rule acquisition and feature-specification solve counts are not purchase ranking quality.

candidates.name: Label-free destination bundle routing from a tiny source bank
candidates.mechanism_novelty: Learn a frozen route/abstain policy from source outcomes and destination prefix descriptors; no destination validation selection.
candidates.source_support_scope: Relatron published selector uses destination labels and its bank is not freely supplied by README; proposed label-free ablation and tiny synthetic bank are ours.
candidates.earliest_falsifier: Indistinguishable unlabelled descriptors with opposed synthetic label mechanisms must trigger abstention; held-out schema regret must beat global source default.
candidates.target_metric_non_equivalence: Synthetic query-ranking regret, Relatron AUROC and actual daily full-purchase-Y NDCG are distinct.

rejected_direct_transfer.method: Relational Transformer direct zero-shot REES ranking
rejected_direct_transfer.reason: Paper explicitly lists recommendation/link prediction unsupported; past task-table labels contribute to transfer.
